parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: The Client ID of the application to get list of associated chat rooms from.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Filters Chat on the basis of their attributes, ?attributes=key:value

title.description: Set an optional title for the Chat Room

content_filter.description: To manage the type of messages allowed in a chat room, we provide three levels of content filtering. Each level determines how messages are moderated and who is allowed to post. **1.** `none`: No content filtering, all users can post freely.  **2.**`filtered`: Profanity is automatically filtered.  **3.** `producer`: Only producers can post, others can view messages only. **4.** `ai`: If a message is recognized by an AI model as being objectionable, it will be filtered.

visibility.description: Who is allowed to see and join the chat room.  Can be `everyone` or `members`.

sponsor_ids.description: Sets the sponsors associated with the chat room

token_gates.description: Set an optional crypto token gates over chat

contract_address.description: address of smart contract whose token will be used as gate

network_type.description: define network in which above contract is a block

attributes.description: Attributes are only attched with non-fungible type token-gates

title.description: Set an optional title for the Chat Room

content_filter.description: To manage the type of messages allowed in a chat room, we provide three levels of content filtering. Each level determines how messages are moderated and who is allowed to post. **1.** `none`: No content filtering, all users can post freely.  **2.**`filtered`: Profanity is automatically filtered.  **3.** `producer`: Only producers can post, others can view messages only. **4.** `ai`: If a message is recognized by an AI model as being objectionable, it will be filtered.

visibility.description: Who is allowed to see and join the chat room.  Can be `everyone` or `members`.

sponsor_ids.description: Links the sponsors with this chat room. Note that only valid sponsor IDs will be linked to a chatroom.

token_gates.description: Token gates users must pass to access the chat

contract_address.description: Contract address of required token in EVM format

pubnub_timetoken.description: If a PubNub Time Token is also provided then the message will be deleted from room history in addition to a `message-deleted` event being published.

post.description: Send a custom message to a chat room.  This can be used to send rich data as a chat message that can be interpreted by the SDK to perform some action or display additional content.

custom_data.description: String data to send with the chat message.  Typically contains a string JSON payload to be decoded by the client SDK

program_date_time.description: ISO-8601 Program Date Time to associate with the chat message.
